integrity: Stand-alone analytic proof with an independent finite standard-library checker; computational tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to exactly three infinite externally tangent cylinders at fixed positive radius ratios; stability is local with weight-dependent constants. Equal-radius threshold, Descartes identity and equal-ball quadratic decay are classical background. No independent validation.
title: Sharp square-root rigidity and twisted skew witnesses for three weighted cylinders around a sphere
